title: 2026 AMC 8 Problem 8
statement: A poll asked a number of people if they liked solving mathematics problems. Exactly \(74\%\) answered “yes.” What is the fewest possible number of people who could have been asked the question?

solutions.text: Exactly \(74\%=\frac{74}{100}=\frac{37}{50}\) of the people answered yes. The total number of people must therefore be a multiple of \(50\), and \(50\) people is possible.
hints: Write \(74\%\) as a fraction of the total
Reduce the percentage fraction and use its denominator
